title: Site index (m @ 50 yr bh) estimates for major viable crop tree species by site series
source_document: Klinka, K., P. Varga, C. Trethewey, C. Koot, M. Rau, J. Macku, and T. Kusbach. 2004. Site Units of the University of British Columbia Alex Fraser Research Forest. 108 pp.
transcription: Manual transcription from the published tables; checked against the rendered page images at 300 dpi.
notes: Site index is metres at 50 years breast height.
The report uses a nominal 5-class growth scale: 1 highest, 5 lowest.
Limits are recorded in the status and note columns; they are not silently converted to exact values.
The report estimates only Douglas-fir, lodgepole pine and hybrid spruce. Other species are not estimated.
The spatial site-series map is not in the PDF and is still outstanding.
